in_marathi.name: Manjay
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manjay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manjay in Sanskrit means 'victorious'. This name is derived from the word 'manj', which means 'to conquer'. It is a powerful and inspiring name for a baby boy.
